title: Midnight Nightmares
description: Bring dread to every bed in your horror modpack
body: Description Midnight Nightmares is a horror version of the Midnight Thoughts mod. It introduces a spooky overlay during sleep that fits perfectly into any horror modpack The overlay is fully customizable: slide speed, custom text, text animation speed, eye animation speed, and the brightness of the overlay itself — everything is adjustable The mod works perfectly on servers, does not disrupt game balance, and serves as a cosmetic storytelling tool. It is compatible with all popular sleep mods
